- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No changes to core functionality or tools—documentation update and cleanup only.
Full rewrite to new standard: added tool reference tables, 3-step GIF table, architecture diagram, code examples, error handling, and troubleshooting.

Initial release of the Razorpay Payments skill.

- Manage customers, orders, invoices, payment links, refunds, payouts, and payments via the Razorpay API.
- Uses ClawLink for secure connection and authentication—no need to provide API keys directly.
- Provides setup instructions for integrating with OpenClaw and connecting your Razorpay account.
- Includes a comprehensive list of tools for both reading and writing Razorpay data.
- Emphasizes security by requiring explicit user confirmation for all write and high-impact operations.
